subject: Re: Kiteware launch support — combined credits & discount request
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@kiteware.io>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Launch support request — combined credits + discount

Hi Stephanie,

Big week for us — Kiteware is scheduled to go live with the pilot customers in two weeks. Our board asked if Redwood can do two things to help accelerate adoption:

- Extend our trial window by 30 days (current trial ends Aug 7)
- Provide $15k in account credits applied over the first quarter and a 20% discount on consumption billing for the first 90 days

We know this is an exception ask. If you need usage numbers, attached is our Q2 usage report and a draft PO we can issue once terms are agreed.

Can you let me know what approvals are required and an estimated turnaround? We need to confirm by Aug 4 to keep the partner launch calendar.

Thanks,
Elena Morales
VP, GTM — Kiteware
Elena: 415-555-0123

Attachment(s): usage_report_kiteware_Q2.csv, kw_PO_4587.pdf
---
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@kiteware.io>
Cc: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@kiteware.io>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch support request — combined credits + discount

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the clear ask and the PO. This is the sort of launch-incentive we evaluate for strategic early partners. I need to route this to finance/leadership for an exception sign-off because it combines an upfront credit and a time-bound discount.

I'll pull together a short package for Marcus and include recommended guardrails (monthly cap on credits, usage thresholds to trigger discount). Can you confirm whether the $15k is intended to be applied as a one-time account credit or as a committed consumption credit? Also: are there any export/hosting constraints we should be aware of (data residency)?

I’ll get back with an internal timeline — aiming for an answer by Tue, Aug 3.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Enterprise Account Exec | Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.com
---
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Kiteware launch support — exec approval request (credits + discount)

Folks — forwarding Kiteware's ask. Key points: $15k account credits + 20% consumption discount for 90 days; they want decision by Aug 4 to keep launch schedule. Attached: usage report, draft PO, and the draft launch support terms I prepared (kiteware_launch_terms_v1.pdf).

Recommend we approve conditionally if we:
- Limit account credit application to first 6 weeks and cap monthly redeemable at $7.5k
- Require signed PO and pre-commit to a minimum $X spend after discount (TBD)
- Set clear rollback if usage or onboarding milestones aren't met

Marissa — do you want to own the financial terms? Dylan — can you confirm we have the capacity to guarantee the short-term SLOs for their launch date?

Thanks,
Stephanie

Attachment(s): kiteware_launch_terms_v1.pdf, usage_report_kiteware_Q2.csv
---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Exec approval request — Kiteware launch incentives (requesting Marcus sign-off)

Marcus —

Quick approval ask. Stephanie + Kiteware are requesting: 30-day trial extension, $15k account credit to assist launch, and a 20% usage discount for first 90 days. They are an early partner with strong GTM alignment; this is a short-term acceleration ask tied to their pilot customer kickoff.

We propose the following guardrails we can operationalize quickly:
- $15k credited to account, redeemable only in the first 45 days, with a monthly cap of $7.5k
- 20% discount applies to metered usage after credits are exhausted, for a maximum of 90 days from approval
- Signed PO and one-page SOW required before credits are provisioned
- Technical readiness check (Dylan) to confirm infra capacity 48 hours before launch

Financial impact estimate: ~ $9k in realized discount over 90 days assuming forecasted consumption (see attached hypothetical run-rate). This is expected to materially aid their conversion to a paid contract.

Can you approve this exception? If yes, please reply with any edits or explicit approval so I can issue updated terms and DocuSign.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
Attachment(s): kiteware_launch_terms_v1.pdf
---
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Aug 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec approval request — Kiteware launch incentives (approved with conditions)

Approve with conditions. I support the incentive; it's small relative to potential ARR and helps with the partner launch. Conditions:

1) Credits limited to $15k, redeemable within 45 days; no rollover.
2) 20% discount only applies after credits are used and capped at $12k realized discount total.
3) PO and signed SOW on file before provisioning; finance to confirm PO number.
4) Require a short onboarding milestone checklist (Dylan to confirm).

Marissa/Stephanie: proceed to DocuSign and capture the PO. Once the PO is in finance, ops can provision the trial extension and credits. Dylan: confirm capacity in the next 24 hours.

-Marcus
VP, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com
---
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@kiteware.io>, Sanjay Rao <sanjay@kiteware.io>

Date: Tue, 03 Aug 2027 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kiteware launch support — approval and next steps

Elena / Sanjay —

Good news: leadership has approved the launch support request with the following final terms (condensed):

- 30-day trial extension (new trial end date: Sep 6)
- $15,000 account credit, redeemable within 45 days of provisioning; monthly redemption capped at $7,500
- 20% consumption discount for up to 90 days, only after credits are exhausted; realized discount capped at $12,000
- Requirement: signed PO (we received kw_PO_4587.pdf) and one-page SOW before credits are provisioned
- Onboarding readiness check by Dylan 48h before live launch

Next steps:
1) Elena — please confirm PO number and sign the SOW when Marissa sends the DocuSign link.
2) Marissa — I’ll send the updated terms for signature and loop in Finance for provisioning once PO is confirmed.
3) Dylan — please confirm capacity check by Wed, Aug 4 EOD.

We’ll provision the trial extension and credits once the signed PO/SOW are in Finance.

Thanks all — excited to see Kiteware go live.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Enterprise Account Exec | Redwood Inference
